name: cursor-accounts
description: Manage Cursor accounts and show plan quota usage in the status bar without opening Settings.

commands.title: Cursor Accounts: Open Usage in Settings

cursorAccounts.refresh.enabled.description: Automatically refresh quota data from Cursor.

cursorAccounts.statusBar.showIncluded.description: Show included quota usage progress in the status bar.

cursorAccounts.statusBar.showTotal.description: Show total plan usage percentage in the status bar.

cursorAccounts.statusBar.showAccountEmai.description: Append logged-in email (read from local Cursor auth cache) to tooltips.

cursorAccounts.profiles.autoDetectRunnin.description: Automatically detect running Cursor instances for each profile.

cursorAccounts.profiles.showProfileInSta.description: Show current profile name in the status bar.

cursorAccounts.profiles.refreshAllInterv.description: Interval in seconds for refreshing all profile quotas.

cursorAccounts.profiles.instanceDetectio.description: Interval in seconds for detecting running Cursor instances.

scripts.build:all: pnpm run compile && pnpm run package:all:fast
scripts.package: node scripts/prepare-bin-for-target.mjs $(node -p "process.platform + '-' + process.arch") && vsce package --allow-missing-repository --no-rewrite-relative-links; node scripts/restore-bin.mjs
